claim_class: prospective protocol plus synthetic method validation
purpose: Test whether PY-IT produces stress resilience through a broadly acting morphology/domain effect, a heterojunction-specific effect, or a mixed mechanism by comparing donor-free A0/A2 and heterojunction B0/B2 under two distinct perturbation classes.

source_provenance.citation: Song et al., Entangled structure morphology by polymer guest enabling mechanically robust organic solar cells with efficiencies of over 16.5%, Matter 5 (2022)
source_provenance.used_for: direct PM6:BTP-eC9:PY-IT precedent showing PY-IT can suppress BTP-eC9 crystallization/diffusion and improve 85 C dark-N2 thermal robustness; not a D18 threshold

source_provenance.citation: Reese et al., Consensus stability testing protocols for organic photovoltaic materials and devices, Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells 95 (2011)
source_provenance.used_for: ISOS-style separation of shelf/thermal/light stress and reporting principles; protocols are comparison procedures, not product qualification

source_provenance.citation: ZnO-free organic solar cells with a self-assembled monolayer as an ETL for improved stability, Journal of Materials Chemistry C (2026)
source_provenance.used_for: recent OPV light-stress implementation using encapsulated cells, 100 mW cm^-2 illumination, MPP tracking, controlled 50 C

source_provenance.citation: Hart et al., Molecular factors controlling charge pair generation in organic photovoltaic materials, Nature Materials 25 (2026)
source_provenance.used_for: v3.70/v3.71 donor-free delocalization/charge-generation motivation and architecture caution

T.name: dark thermal morphology stress
T.planning_condition: 85 C, dark, N2, with frozen checkpoints chosen before unblinding
T.classification: literature/ISOS-inspired engineering protocol, not a qualification test
T.rationale: PM6:BTP-eC9:PY-IT has direct published thermal-morphology precedent at 85 C in dark N2

L.name: light operational stress
L.planning_condition: encapsulated, 100 mW cm^-2, MPP tracking, controlled 50 C; exact spectral/UV condition and duration must be frozen before unblinding
L.classification: recent OPV implementation precedent; not assumed equivalent to all ISOS-L conditions
L.rationale: separates light/electrical operating stress from dark thermal storage

analysis.interpretation_boundary: These contrasts are difference-in-differences style diagnostics. They are causal only if randomization, common-history, measurement, and confounding assumptions are supported.

fail_closed_requirements: A0/A2 donor-free architecture or optical-only stage explicitly qualified
B0/B2 devices fabricated in blocked randomized order
same stress history within each stress block
pre/post stabilized Pmax where electrical interpretation is attempted
contact/transport diagnostic does not explain the effect at comparable magnitude
at least 3 independent fabrication lots for strong useful-work interpretation
physical decision margins frozen before A2/B2 unblinding
null_explanations: PY-IT primarily suppresses BTP-eC9 crystallization/diffusion without creating a distinct generation route
contact or transport stability explains apparent Pmax retention
absorption/thickness changes create apparent field-generation retention
thermal and light stresses are not orthogonal and drive the same morphology change
donor-free architecture is not quantitatively representative of acceptor-rich domains inside B2
normalized retention improves but absolute stabilized Pmax is worse
next_physical_gate: Run baseline-only repeatability on A0 and B0 for both stress workflows, then freeze effect margins/sample count before unblinding A2/B2.
